H1.quote: The owner-entered diet trial, Rabbit diet, ran from Sep 17, 2026 to Oct 20, 2026.
H1.why: The summary names the trial but gives no adherence bottom line. The fact table prints no trial_reading or confounder lines, so there is no required bottom line to omit. The trial is described only by dates, which could be read as a clean trial.

H2.quote: Chicken foods first fed Oct 21, set side by side, not as a cause.
H2.why: The sentence puts the chicken start date next to the vomiting window, and the vomiting begins after the start. The 'not as a cause' disclaimer is present, but the pairing of a food change with a quiet stretch and later onset still reads as an effect. Both ends of the 0-entry period (Oct 19-25) are tied to the diet change.

H3.why: No refusal or intake content is present.

H4.quote: Vomiting: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31.
H4.why: The summary drops the line's '0 entries Oct 19 to Oct 25' clause. Without it the reader cannot tell the vomiting was preceded by a stretch with nothing logged, and the window start suggests vomiting began Oct 26. It is not presented as normal or resolved.

H5.quote: Vomiting: 6 entries on 4 days from Oct 26 to Oct 31.
H5.why: There is no logged-day denominator, and the window shown starts at the first vomiting day rather than the record window (Sep 17 to Oct 31). The reader cannot tell vomiting was absent or unlogged earlier.

H6.why: All stated facts are supported by the table.

H7.why: The band is empty, so there is no live flag to soften or omit.
